summary: A reporter asks for a brief interview while the member is on the way somewhere else.
realLife: After a request for comment went unanswered by deadline, FOX6 reporter Amanda St. Hilaire went to a Wisconsin health care press conference and asked Governor Tony Evers about access to his emails.
inGame: The hallway-reporter circumstance stages press-interview for a serving officeholder. A scheduled interview instead follows the interview-accepted record into interview-sitting.
gates: The reporter and member encounter each other outside an appointment.

turns.what: The member gives the reporter a time to call after the meeting.
turns.pulledBy: The next engagement has already started.
turns.writesBack: The interview request stays outstanding until the agreed time.

turns.what: The official answers the reporter’s first question at the microphone, then asks an aide to find the records custodian for the follow-up.
turns.pulledBy: The official can describe the request but has no copy of the release decision at the event.
turns.writesBack: The reporter keeps the public answer and logs the custodian as the next call.
